what_it_is: Triangular allograft implant for minimally invasive SI joint stabilization and fusion. Designed for intra-articular placement with procedural decortication. Decreases SI joint motion. Allograft-based (bone graft, not titanium).
indications: Minimally invasive SI joint stabilization and fusion.
use_notes: Simple technique designed for reproducible placement. Compared favorably vs competitor rectangular ridged allograft in biomechanical testing (Technical Study 301310-TS). Increases biomechanical stabilization.
